map.由调制波与载波幅度求调幅指数: AM modulation index from modulating and carrier amplitudes
map.📖 查看「由调制波与载波幅度求调幅指数 使用指南」: View "AM modulation index from modulating and carrier amplitudes" guide
map.输入调制波幅度 Am 与载波幅度 Ac，求调幅指数。: Enter modulating-wave amplitude Am and carrier amplitude Ac to find the AM modulation index.
map.m = A_m/A_c，m≤1 无过调制。: m = A_m/A_c, m<=1 means no overmodulation.
map.调幅波调制指数 m = 调幅分量/载波幅度。: For an AM wave, modulation index m = modulating component / carrier amplitude.
map.判断是否过调幅（m>1 失真）。: Determine whether overmodulation occurs (m>1 causes distortion).
map.调制指数 m = 2 / 5 = 0.40，属于正常调幅（m<1 不失真）。: Modulation index m = 2 / 5 = 0.40, normal AM (m<1, no distortion).
map.若 m=1.2（>1），则包络过零反转产生严重失真，应避免。: If m=1.2 (>1), the envelope crosses zero and reverses, causing severe distortion; it should be avoided.
map.过调幅使包络不再与调制信号成正比，解调后出现截断失真。: Overmodulation makes the envelope no longer proportional to the modulating signal, producing clipping distortion after demodulation.
map.边带功率占比随 m² 增长，m 越大信息功率占比越高但越易过调。: The sideband power ratio grows with m^2; a larger m raises the information-power share but also the risk of overmodulation.
